note: Round 192, the glass towers: the curtain-wall systems the outer glass shader draws (app.js GLASS_SYS) and which tower wears which. Hand-authored from the references in each entry. bay and floor in metres; nbM x nfM the module (bays by floors) one atlas cell holds; F0 the exterior visible reflectance of the whole unit at normal incidence, VLT its visible transmittance; coatSat how much of the body colour the reflection takes (a coloured coating); pillow and roller the pane's slopes in radians (a sealed unit's bow, a tempered pane's roller wave); spandrel kind 0 shadow box, 1 back-painted, 2 frit, 3 opaque stone or metal (from the atlas); rooms by kind (office, home, hotel, mech); upper: above datum metres over the base the glass and rooms change (Comcast's crown, the CTC's hotel, FMC's flats); corner: low-iron glass within that many metres of a wall's end; lobbyH: the clear lobby band at the foot. frame metal: how much of the frame is bare or anodized metal (a PVDF-painted mullion or cap is mostly paint: Round 192's review set the painted ones from 0.6 to 0.85 down to 0.25 to 0.45, the shadow boxes' pans a lit mid grey; Comcast's flush joints dark silicone, Liberty's frame its silver caps and blue-grey granite at their mean (#6E849B: the second review; the first review's #283542 had darkened it against a frame drawn at nearly four times its register), the residential wall's slab covers a weathered light grey, not the art's white, against the swatches in tests/test_glass_calibration.py). body: the glass's default colour (the vertex colour, set in the towers' register: hex x 0.66); a tower's body is its photographed glass (Round 192's third review: by day the shader takes the glass's reflectance from it in linear light, at uGlassW.z, and the system's F0 only as the share its corners, crown and lobby keep, and its measured reflectance after dark; coatSat 1 everywhere, the body's hue whole; the swatches of glass_calibrate.py are the bodies). frame slim (Round 192's second review): the joints the bake thins the generated elevation's frame to, metres: v the vertical joint's sightline, h the opaque rows a floor (Comcast's flush unitized joints read as a white grid at about 150 mm and 276 mm; the generic unitized wall the same); frame colours and spandrel backs are the colour a surface shows in the sun, drawn at the fabric's register (FACADE_GAIN).
